title: Google Cloud Security Products, AI Security and Trust

header.html: 5. Trust and security with Google Cloud (about 18%)

5.2 Describe the business value of making Google part of an organization's security team: how Google Cloud secures every layer of the AI stack; Google Threat Intelligence; Security Command Center; Google Security Operations; Google's secure-by-design platform; AI-assisted and AI-focused security offerings (Gemini in Google Security Operations, AI Protection, Model Armor); other security offerings; how Google Cloud earns and maintains customer trust
the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide

toc.title: Google Security Operations and AI security

html:
1Secure by design

Google Cloud uses a defense-in-depth, multilayered approach, so Google acts as part of your security team.

Layer What Google does
Core infrastructure Own data centers, purpose-built servers and networking, custom security hardware and software
Network Google's global private network and DDoS protection
Platform and services Encryption by default and security built into products
Identity and access IAM, two-step verification
Operations Threat intelligence and security operations at Google scale

The AI stack has layers too: infrastructure, data, models, platform and agents. Google Cloud secures every layer, so organizations can use AI safely.

Exam tip

. Secure by design means security starts in the hardware and software Google builds itself, not as an add-on.

2Google Threat Intelligence

Point Fact
Purpose Proactive insight into who is targeting you and how, so you can set defenses and respond
Sources Google's vast global visibility, Mandiant's frontline incident response expertise, VirusTotal's crowdsourced threat detection
Result A unified verdict and context about threats; Gemini helps surface the threats that matter to you

3Security Command Center (SCC)

Security Command Center discovers, prioritizes and remediates security risks and misconfigurations across the Google Cloud environment.

Capability Meaning
Posture management Finds misconfigurations and vulnerabilities without agents
Threat detection Detects active threats in near real time
AI protection Finds AI assets, prioritizes risk, secures models and agents
Virtual red teaming Simulates attackers to find attack paths
Compliance Manager Tracks compliance and evidence
Data security posture management Finds and monitors sensitive data

4Google Security Operations and AI security

Product What it does
Google Security Operations Unified security operations platform: collects telemetry at scale and speeds detection, investigation and response (SIEM and SOAR)
Gemini in Google Security Operations AI assistant that summarizes threats, helps investigate and writes queries
AI Protection Discover, assess and protect AI workloads (within Security Command Center)
Model Armor Screens prompts and responses of AI models for prompt injection, sensitive data leakage and harmful content
Exam tip

. Model Armor protects AI conversations. Security Command Center finds and prioritizes risk. Google Security Operations detects and responds.

5Other security offerings

Product Use
Cloud VPC Private, isolated virtual network
Cloud VPN Encrypted tunnel over the internet to your network
Cloud Interconnect Dedicated or partner private connection to your network
Firewalls Rules that allow or block traffic
Cloud Armor Protects applications from DDoS and web attacks
Cloud Logging Collects logs for auditing and investigation
IAM Who can do what on which resource
Sensitive Data Protection Discover, classify and de-identify sensitive data (formerly Cloud Data Loss Prevention)
Confidential Computing Encrypts data while it is in use inside the processor
Certificate Manager Manages TLS certificates for secure connections
Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) Application-level access by user identity and context, without a VPN

6Trust, residency and compliance

Topic Fact
Transparency reports Google publishes how it handles government requests for data
Third-party audits Independent auditors verify controls against recognized standards
Data residency Where data is stored; customers can choose regions
Digital sovereignty Control over data, operations and access under local law
Compliance resource center Reports and certifications that help meet industry and regional compliance
Exam tip

. Trust comes from transparency and independent proof: transparency reports and third-party audits. Residency = where the data sits.

7Exam Q&A

7.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A company wants to know which threat actors target its industry, using insight from Google, Mandiant and VirusTotal. Which product fits?

  • ACloud Armor, a network protection service
  • BGoogle Threat Intelligence
  • CCloud VPN, an encrypted tunnel
  • DSensitive Data Protection, a data classifier
Show the answer

Answer: B. Google Threat Intelligence combines Google's visibility, Mandiant's expertise and VirusTotal's database.

S2A security team wants to find misconfigurations and vulnerabilities across its Google Cloud environment and rank the risks. Which product fits?

  • ASecurity Command Center
  • BCloud Interconnect, a private connection
  • CCertificate Manager, for TLS certificates
  • DConfidential Computing, for data in use
Show the answer

Answer: A. Security Command Center discovers, prioritizes and remediates risks and misconfigurations.

S3A company runs a chatbot and wants to block prompt injection and prevent sensitive data from leaking in answers. Which product fits?

  • ACloud DNS, which resolves domain names
  • BModel Armor, which screens prompts and responses
  • CCloud VPC, which isolates networks
  • DCloud Storage, which stores objects
Show the answer

Answer: B. Model Armor protects AI prompts and responses against prompt injection, leakage and harmful content.

S4A team wants one platform to ingest telemetry, detect threats and speed up response, with AI help. Which product fits?

  • AApigee, for API management
  • BGoogle Security Operations, with Gemini
  • CLooker, for business dashboards
  • DDataflow, for data pipelines
Show the answer

Answer: B. Google Security Operations is the unified security operations platform, with Gemini to assist analysts.

S5A company wants to protect data while it is being processed in memory. Which technology fits?

  • ACloud Logging, which collects logs
  • BConfidential Computing, which encrypts data in use
  • CCloud Armor, which blocks web attacks
  • DCloud Interconnect, which links networks
Show the answer

Answer: B. Confidential Computing encrypts data in use in the processor.

S6A customer must keep its data in a specific country to meet local rules. Which concept applies?

  • AData residency, the location where data is stored
  • BAutoscaling, which adds capacity when demand rises
  • CStreaming analytics, which processes events
  • DAgentic AI, which acts toward goals
Show the answer

Answer: A. Data residency is the choice of where data is stored, which Google Cloud lets customers control.

7.2 Recall questions

R1What are the three sources of Google Threat Intelligence?

Show the answer

Google's visibility, Mandiant and VirusTotal.

R2What does Model Armor protect?

Show the answer

AI prompts and responses.

R3What does Cloud Armor protect against?

Show the answer

DDoS and web attacks.

R4What does Identity-Aware Proxy do?

Show the answer

Gives application access by identity and context, without a VPN.

R5What does Confidential Computing protect?

Show the answer

Data in use.

R6How does Google show trust?

Show the answer

Transparency reports and third-party audits.
